name: bookvie
description: Local-first home library and reading tracker.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend exec -- playwright install chromium
scripts.check: npm run check:py && npm run check:api && npm run check:e2e && npm run check:smoke
scripts.check:py: cd backend && TZ=Europe/Madrid uv run pytest --cov=bookvie --cov-report=term --cov-report=json:.coverage.json && uv run python scripts/coverage_gate.py .coverage.json
scripts.check:e2e: npm run build && TZ=Europe/Madrid npm --prefix frontend run e2e
scripts.e2e:burn-in: npm run build && TZ=Europe/Madrid npm --prefix frontend run e2e -- --repeat-each=10 --retries=0 && node scripts/e2e-count.mjs --repeat-each=10
